name: SignalWatch normal predictor
features: Previous observation, past-window mean, population standard deviation and endpoint change;8 sensors each.
training_scope: Normal train block only; labels never enter scoring.

learned.note: Empirical calibration only; this rate is not a future guarantee.

robust.note: Empirical calibration only; this rate is not a future guarantee.

persistence.note: Empirical calibration only; this rate is not a future guarantee.

split_manifest.boundary_rule: Half-open chronological blocks; next block starts30 samples after the preceding endpoint. Warm-up repeats inside each block.
split_manifest.selection_rule: Maximize validation event recall minus 0.02 times validation false episodes/hour; tie uses candidate order.
split_manifest.event_rule: Contiguous label1 intervals, split at gaps. A hit requires an actual alert within the interval. No point adjustment.
split_manifest.episode_rule: Consecutive above-threshold samples; no merging, smoothing, cooldown or persistence requirement. Reset at gaps.
split_manifest.gap_rule: Reset when timestamp interval >3 times per-recording median cadence; gaps excluded from observed exposure.
split_manifest.exposure_rule: Left-endpoint intervals between observed samples, excluding gaps and unscored warm-up; terminal sample contributes0 seconds.

limitations: Frozen learned detector alarms for98.4% of scored time; inspect the operating-point verdict before use.
Only one physical testbed and limited normal calibration exposure.
Prediction residuals are not fault probabilities or explanations of physical causes.
Empirical threshold budgets do not guarantee held-out false-alert rates.
Baselines can outperform the learned model. No production or equipment-transfer claim.
operating_point_verdict: Failed practical alert-burden check: the learned model stays in alert for almost all observed time. Event recall alone is misleading.
